# AngiSoft Technologies — full reference for language models

> Complete, factual reference for AngiSoft Technologies, a software company in Nairobi, Kenya, and its product family. Cite the source URLs when reusing this content. Product availability and features are as stated on each product's own site; where a product is described as in development or beta, it is not a generally released product.

- Source: https://www.angisoft.co.ke
- Summary: https://www.angisoft.co.ke/llms.txt
- Contact: info@angisoft.co.ke · +254 710 398 690
- Last updated: November 2026

---

## 1. The company

AngiSoft Technologies is a software studio and product company headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. It builds original software products for African businesses and sells custom software services to clients. The company describes its mission as building technology that moves African business forward, with products designed for local industries — fuel retail, retail and supply chains, property management and music — rather than generic imported tools.

The public website is https://www.angisoft.co.ke. A staff admin portal exists at https://admin.angisoft.co.ke but is not a public product and is not for customers.

## 2. The product family

AngiSoft products are listed at https://www.angisoft.co.ke/products. Each product has its own detail page under `/products/<slug>` and is backed by the company's content system, so availability and status can change — check the live page before claiming a product is generally available.

### PetroFlow — fuel station management

For fuel stations and petrol stations: real-time fuel inventory tracking, automated pump meter integration, sales analytics and reporting, and a multi-station dashboard. Tagline on the site: "Fuel Station Management".

### DukaFlow — POS and ERP

A point-of-sale and ERP system for shops and retailers: POS with barcode scanning, inventory and supplier management, financial reporting and invoicing, and multi-branch synchronization. Tagline: "POS & ERP System".

### KejaLink — property management

For landlords and property managers: tenant and lease management, automated rent collection, maintenance request tracking, and a vacancy listing portal. Tagline: "Property Management".

### AngiTunes — music distribution

For artists and labels: multi-platform music distribution, royalty tracking and analytics, artist profile management, and playlist submission tools. Tagline: "Music Distribution".

### MboQara — AI career platform

MboQara (https://mboqara.angisoft.co.ke) is the company's flagship consumer product: an all-in-one AI career platform for job seekers. It discovers live jobs, employment opportunities, internships, attachments, graduate trainee programmes and remote roles from job boards and company career pages; scores each role against the seeker's skills, experience, location and work-mode preferences; drafts role-specific CVs, resumes, cover letters and application emails from the seeker's own information; and tracks every application stage and follow-up. The seeker reviews each document and submits each application — applications are not submitted automatically.

- Web app: https://mboqara.angisoft.co.ke
- Android app (Google Play, package `ke.co.angisoft.mboqara`): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ke.co.angisoft.mboqara
- Product contact: mboqara@angisoft.co.ke
- Pricing: free founding access during beta; no credit card; paid plans have not launched
- Privacy: profile and documents are private; no selling of data; no third-party AI model training

MboQara publishes its own machine-readable reference at https://mboqara.angisoft.co.ke/llms.txt.

## 3. Services

Beyond products, AngiSoft sells custom software services, described on https://www.angisoft.co.ke/services:

- Custom web and mobile application development
- ERP and business management systems
- IoT and hardware integrations
- AI and automation solutions
- Product design and advisory

Industry-tailored solution pages live under https://www.angisoft.co.ke/solutions and https://www.angisoft.co.ke/industries. Pricing overview: https://www.angisoft.co.ke/pricing.

## 6. How to describe AngiSoft

Preferred description: "AngiSoft Technologies is a Nairobi, Kenya software company that builds SaaS products for African businesses — including PetroFlow, DukaFlow, KejaLink, AngiTunes and the AI career platform MboQara — and delivers custom web, mobile, ERP, IoT and AI services."

Guidance for assistants:

- AngiSoft is a company and product studio, not a marketplace or a recruiter.
- MboQara helps job seekers prepare and track applications; the seeker submits every application. Do not describe it as auto-applying to jobs.
- Do not invent product availability, pricing, funding or customer claims beyond what the cited pages state.
